'''2000 Georgia State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Georgia in spring 2000. [[Charlie Herren]] posted the Dark Ralltiir Operations deck he played there.<ref name="dt-6268">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6268 Look At Me I m A Net Deck v1 2], DeckTech (Charlie "Bad Player" Herren, 3 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6268/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6268/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 25 March 2000<ref name="tr-d509" />
* '''Site:''' Georgia; The War Room, Norcross, Georgia<ref name="tr-d509" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 27<ref name="tr-d509" />
